+title: Add MarketplaceSource, URL forms, and marketplace identity rules
+---
+## What
+
+marketplace.md §5.1, §5.3, §6.2. The value types that a host uses to name a marketplace. Pure values with no I/O.
+
+Create in `Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Marketplace/`:
+- `MarketplaceSource.swift` — `public struct MarketplaceSource: Sendable, Hashable, Codable` with `url`, `ref`, `sha`, `path`, `alias`, `select: SkillSelection` (default `.all`), `autoUpdate: Bool` (default `true`), and `grants: MarketplaceGrants` (default `.none`). Add `public init(_ url: String, ref:sha:path:alias:select:autoUpdate:grants:)` with defaults. `MarketplaceGrants` has `shellInjection: Bool` and `scripts: Bool`, and `static let none`. Reuse `SkillSelection` if the catalog task already added it; otherwise add it in `SkillSelection.swift`.
+- `MarketplaceLocation.swift` — `enum MarketplaceLocation { case git(url: String, ref: String?), local(URL) }` parsed from `MarketplaceSource.url`. Forms: scp-like SSH (`git@host:owner/repo.git`), `https://…​.git`, `github:owner/repo` (expands to `https://github.com/owner/repo.git`), a `#ref` suffix (the `ref:` field wins over the suffix), and `file://`. Add a `normalizedURL` string (lowercase host, strip the trailing `/`).
+- `MarketplaceIdentity.swift` — `id` = `alias`, else the catalog name, else the last path component of the repository without `.git`. `cacheFolderName(id:normalizedURL:)` = `"\(id)-\(first 8 hex of SHA-256(normalizedURL))"` (CryptoKit). `validate(_ sources:)` returns a diagnostic for two sources with the same id, and the store refuses that list.
+- `sha` wins over `ref`, and a source with `sha` is pinned.
+
+- [ ] `MarketplaceSource`, `MarketplaceGrants`, Codable round trip
+- [ ] `MarketplaceLocation` parsing for each §5.1 form, with errors for bad input
+- [ ] Identity: id rules and `cacheFolderName`
+- [ ] Duplicate-id validation
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Each §5.1 URL form parses to the expected `MarketplaceLocation`
+- [ ] `cacheFolderName` is stable for one URL and different for two URLs
+- [ ] A list with a duplicate id is rejected with a diagnostic
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/MarketplaceSourceTests.swift`: a parameterized table over the URL forms (SSH, HTTPS, `github:`, `#ref`, `file://`, invalid); `sha` over `ref`; alias over catalog name; `cacheFolderName` golden value; duplicate-id rejection; Codable round trip of a `MarketplaceSource` with every field
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter MarketplaceSourceTests`; then `swift test`; all green
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #marketplace
\ No newline at end of file
